replaces.idea: A compact phosphor-green CRT setup terminal on a pedestal base with a sloped keyboard lip and three horizontal menu bars on its screen.
A wall-mounted rotary selector dial on a square backplate with four stepped detent notches and a pointer knob.
A standing contactor relay housing with a visible coil and a pivoted mechanical armature bar bridging its top contacts.
A bracket-mounted dual-BIOS toggle switch with a hinged flip-up safety guard lifted open above a tilted metal lever.

new.name: Boot Selector Dial
new.depicts: A wall-mounted circular rotary selector dial on a square backplate with four stepped detent notches around the rim and a pointer knob turned to the top-left notch.
new.focal: The pointer knob aimed at one of the four stepped detent notches.

new.name: Dual-BIOS Guard Switch
new.depicts: A small bracket-mounted toggle switch with a hinged flip-up safety guard lifted open, exposing a metal bat-handle lever tilted to the left.
new.focal: The hinged safety guard flipped open above the tilted lever.

new.name: ACPI Power Relay
new.depicts: A standing rectangular contactor relay housing with a visible coil, a pivoted mechanical armature bar on top, and two heavy bottom terminal lugs.
new.focal: The pivoted mechanical armature bar bridging the top contacts.

new.name: Pre-Boot Terminal
new.depicts: A compact phosphor-green CRT terminal sitting on a pedestal base with a sloped front keyboard lip and a recessed screen showing three horizontal menu bars.
new.focal: The recessed CRT screen glowing with three horizontal menu bars.

new.name: PXE Keystone Jack
new.depicts: A small floor-standing RJ45 keystone jack block with a latched Ethernet plug seated inside and a tiny glowing link LED on its top bezel.
new.focal: The latched Ethernet plug seated in the keystone jack.

rework.redesign: Mount the circular piezo speaker on a small L-shaped metal bracket with a flat base foot so it stands grounded on the floor.
